title: Ford's AI Regret: Welcome Back Human Engineers!

scenes.text: Ford is re-hiring human engineers after AI failed them!
The company found that AI systems couldn't match the expertise of veteran engineers.
This decision reflects a broader trend where companies are realizing AI can't replace human skill.
Human knowledge is irreplaceable; firms must consider their teams carefully.
scenes.label: VALUE HUMAN SKILL

scenes.text: Follow for the future, one byte at a time.
